about_short_description.short_description: DeepSource is a unified DevSecOps platform that helps companies write secure code with static analysis and AI.

product.name: DeepSource Unified DevSecOps Platform
product.description: A platform that integrates static analysis, software composition analysis, code quality checks, infrastructure as code security, and code coverage to secure and improve code throughout the development lifecycle.

product.name: DeepSource Agents
product.description: Autonomous agents that monitor codebases, analyze security issues using AI reasoning, and automatically fix vulnerabilities and dependency problems by creating pull requests and commits.

product.name: Autofix™ AI
product.description: An AI-driven automated remediation engine that generates context-aware code fixes for detected issues and proposes them as pull requests for developer review and approval.

product.name: Core Static Analyzers
product.description: Static analyzers developed by DeepSource that detect code quality, security, and style issues across multiple programming languages.

product.name: Community Analyzers
product.description: Third-party open-source static analyzers that run externally and report results to DeepSource, expanding language and technology support.
